resourcePolicy: Turbo concurrency 1 and one Vitest tree. Diagnostic HTTP runs were sequential with tests. Final HTTP starts after the final CI healthcare build finishes, overlapping remaining CI tests against the immutable completed build. At launch, available memory was about 23 GB of 31 GB on eight cores. At most one Next server and one API remain active; the independent shell Chromium fixture closes its own browser/Vite after its check. Launcher groups are stopped after each run.
